Aleph Alpha released full Kolibri weights under Apache 2.0; the English–German model has 78.1 billion total parameters, 3.46 billion active per token and a stated one-million-token context limit.

Aleph Alpha’s report gives Kolibri English and German aggregate scores of 75.5% and 70.8%, above the listed mixture-of-experts baselines; long-context training reached 256K tokens, and two customer-proxy sets had 11 and 26 items.
